title: This Primate Screams Where No Human Can Hear a Thing
subject: Philippine tarsier

scenes.text: This tiny primate calls out all night. You would hear nothing at all.
The Philippine tarsier fits in your hand, and scientists once watched it open its mouth in a scream with no sound.
Their equipment found the call: pitched around 70 kilohertz. People stop hearing at about 20.
It is the highest pitch ever recorded from a primate, a range closer to a bat than to a monkey.
Its ears can hear that high, too. Researchers think its predators, like owls and snakes, may hear far worse.
So the tarsier talks in a channel most hunters can't tune into. A secret language, in plain sight.

description:
The Philippine tarsier makes calls around 70 kilohertz, far above the roughly 20 kilohertz limit of human hearing.
It is the highest pitch recorded from a primate, and researchers think it may keep tarsiers' conversations hidden from predators.
What would you say if no one could hear you?
first_comment: A secret language that predators can't hear: which animal would you want to learn it from, a tarsier or a bat?
